fieldValues.title: The three doors as a charter decision record
fieldValues.summary: The three doors and the mode x door merge-rights matrix existed only as CLAUDE.md prose. This unit gives them the shape every comparable rule has: a charter decision record (rfc-decision-e99a9437), a compass roster entry with a citing section, and CLAUDE.md reduced to a pointer.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/622, open for owner merge. The record states Door 1 (execute a recorded ruling, citing its rfc-decision id), Door 2 (new normative meaning via an RFC), Door 3 (amend an accepted RFC's own surface via a revision), and non-normative changes passing through no door; the hard rule that conformance rules and docs/schema/2.0/ never change without one of the three citations; and merge right as decision mode x door. It also carries the external-work clause ruled the same day: a PR depending on an action only the owner can take never self-merges, whatever its mode and door. No new mechanism — check-decision-compass-drift.mjs already binds roster to citing section, so the compass is the guarded home. Gates exit 0: validate-all, release-drift, decision-compass-drift, spec-language.
